guides.title: 光柵耦合器設計：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Grating-coupler design: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 光柵耦合的角度、偏振與波長交互影響。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Grating coupling couples angle, polarization and wavelength. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。來源標示為光子晶片；不把未公開的材料、光源形式或電路功能當作照片可證明的事實。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：光柵耦合的角度、偏振與波長交互影響。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：比較波長角度二維效率圖。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. The source identifies a photonic chip; undisclosed materials, source architecture and circuit function cannot be inferred from appearance.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Grating coupling couples angle, polarization and wavelength. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Compare two-dimensional wavelength-angle efficiency maps. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「比較波長角度二維效率圖」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare two-dimensional wavelength-angle efficiency maps, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 光柵耦合器設計：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.concept: 先用「設定光纖與偏振」建立判讀邊界。耦合目標是特定纖模，不能以任意高斯光斑代替所有纖種。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Specify fiber and polarization to define the interpretation boundary. The target is a specific fiber mode, not any Gaussian beam. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜設定光纖與偏振：觀察焦點：記錄模場直徑及偏振定義。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜使用漸變光柵：觀察焦點：將目標包絡連到每段散射變化。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜交付耦合容差：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：交付峰值、頻寬與位置容差。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Specify fiber and polarization: Observation focus: Record mode-field diameter and polarization. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Use apodization: Observation focus: Relate target envelope to segment scattering. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver coupling tolerances: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Deliver peak efficiency, bandwidth and positional tolerance. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「使用漸變光柵」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付耦合容差：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Use apodization: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver coupling tolerances: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：光柵向上輻射效率就是光纖耦合效率。本步先檢查「設定光纖與偏振」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到耦合目標是特定纖模，不能以任意高斯光斑代替所有纖種。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：光柵向上輻射效率就是光纖耦合效率。本步先檢查「使用漸變光柵」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到漸變散射可塑形出射場，但新增製造容差與最小特徵限制。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Upward radiation efficiency equals fiber coupling efficiency. First check whether evidence for specify fiber and polarization actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: The target is a specific fiber mode, not any Gaussian beam.

Misinterpretation to reject: Upward radiation efficiency equals fiber coupling efficiency. First check whether evidence for use apodization actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Apodized scattering shapes output fields but adds tolerance and feature constraints.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

place.name: imec 魯汶園區（公開研究代表點）
place.coordinateScope: 官方會議場址公布的園區代表座標；本課採用多國公開來源，不主張每一技術在此發明或量產，也不是設備位置。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Campus reference coordinates published for an official event. The course draws on international sources; this is not a claim of local invention, production or equipment location.

courses.summary: 本課以光柵相位匹配、方向性與模場重疊連結材料、模型與驗證。地圖採 imec 公開研究園區作為跨領域整合的代表點；製造、量測及可靠度資料則分別引用材料廠、工具商與研究機構。這個位置提供研究脈絡，不把全球供應鏈誤縮成一處工廠。
courses.summaryEn: This course connects materials, models and validation through grating phase matching, directionality and modal overlap. Imec’s public campus is a reference for interdisciplinary integration; manufacturing, metrology and reliability sources also come from vendors and research institutions. The map provides research context rather than reducing the global supply chain to one factory.

history.title: 合作研究中心在魯汶成立
history.titleEn: A collaborative research center starts in Leuven
history.text: imec 官方歷史記錄其成立背景；共同研究模式使材料、元件和系統問題能在同一研究環境連結。
history.textEn: Imec’s official history records its establishment; collaborative research connects materials, devices and systems in one research environment.

history.title: 微流體散熱連結晶片與系統
history.titleEn: Microfluidic cooling connects chips and systems
history.text: imec 公開介紹矽微流道研究，說明晶片性能需與散熱及封裝一起思考；此為研究展示，不是所有課程的量產規格。
history.textEn: Imec publicly described silicon microchannel research, illustrating the need to consider chip performance together with cooling and packaging. This is a research demonstration, not a production specification for every course.

courses.connection: 將地圖視為研究交流的定位點，再依每個來源了解不同機構在材料、設備、量測與系統驗證上的分工。
courses.connectionEn: Use the map as a research reference, then trace each source’s role in materials, equipment, metrology and system validation.

courses.connection: 從「光柵耦合器設計」的材料、設備、設計、量測或系統整合問題，延伸查閱下列公司與機構的官方資料；這是教材關聯，不代表合作、採購、背書或投資建議。
courses.connectionEn: Explore official information from companies and institutions related to the materials, equipment, design, measurement or system integration in Grating-coupler design. This is a learning association, not a partnership, procurement, endorsement or investment advice.
